# `aube sbom`

- **Usage:** `aube sbom [FLAGS]`
- **Effect:** read-only

Generate a Software Bill of Materials (CycloneDX or SPDX)

## Flags
- **`-D --dev`** — Show only devDependencies
- **`--exclude-peers`** — Exclude peer dependencies from CycloneDX output
- **`--format <FORMAT>`** — Output format: `cyclonedx` (default) or `spdx`

  **Choices:** `cyclonedx`, `spdx`

  **Default:** `cyclonedx`
- **`--lockfile-only`** — Describe the complete platform-independent lockfile graph
- **`-P --prod`** — Show only production dependencies (skip devDependencies)

  **Aliases:** `--production`
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
